description: Generate deal-specific SBA 7(a) SOP 50 10 8.1 Letter of Intent (LOI) clauses and guardrails covering CRE vs. business price allocation before the $3M QoE trigger, full-life standby seller notes, <=24-month 1099 seller consulting caps, working capital true-up vs. buyer rebate routing, partial-buyout covenants, and PLP/LGPC valuation timing.

buyer_cash_equity.description: Buyer cash equity (defaults to 10% of purchase_price for LOI framing if omitted).
buyer_cash_equity.title: Buyer Cash Equity

buyer_employed_months_at_target.description: Months buyer was employed at target (for Owner Buyouts).
buyer_employed_months_at_target.title: Buyer Employed Months At Target

buyer_replacement_salary.description: Annual buyer replacement salary / living draw (USD).
buyer_replacement_salary.title: Buyer Replacement Salary

has_buyer_rebate.description: True if deal includes a performance buyer rebate.
has_buyer_rebate.title: Has Buyer Rebate

has_seller_earnout.description: True if deal includes a seller earnout (prohibited).
has_seller_earnout.title: Has Seller Earnout

has_working_capital_true_up.description: True if PSA includes a working capital true-up.
has_working_capital_true_up.title: Has Working Capital True Up

is_plp_lender.description: True if using a PLP lender; False for non-delegated LGPC.
is_plp_lender.title: Is Plp Lender

owner_occupied_cre_value.description: Appraised owner-occupied CRE value inside purchase_price.
owner_occupied_cre_value.title: Owner Occupied Cre Value

purchase_price.description: Total PSA purchase price in USD, including any owner-occupied CRE.
purchase_price.title: Purchase Price

seller_consulting_months.description: Planned post-closing 1099 seller consulting duration in months.
seller_consulting_months.title: Seller Consulting Months

seller_ebitda_last_fye.description: Target adjusted SDE/EBITDA for last completed fiscal year-end (USD).
seller_ebitda_last_fye.title: Seller Ebitda Last Fye

seller_note_standby_type.description: Seller note standby terms: none, full_life, or partial_or_short.
seller_note_standby_type.title: Seller Note Standby Type

seller_stays_w2_or_officer.description: True if seller plans to stay on W-2 payroll or as officer.
seller_stays_w2_or_officer.title: Seller Stays W2 Or Officer

transaction_type.description: SBA Appendix 15 Change of Ownership category.
transaction_type.title: Transaction Type

veteran_owned_50_pct_or_more.description: True if >=50% post-close ownership is held by Veteran(s).
veteran_owned_50_pct_or_more.title: Veteran Owned 50 Pct Or More
